versions.changelog: Shorten ClawHub summary Free CTA (clawhub_free) so tracked URL does not truncate

What’s new
• Give your OpenClawagent its own inbox — with allowlist and consent before it emails anyone
• Free to try; upgrade to Starter in the app when you need more agents and volume
• Faster setup: step-by-step quickstart at assistant-mail.ai/docs (MCP in your client in a few minutes)
• Agents can reply in-thread, manage approved recipients, and check usage — without guessing mailbox IDs
• Clearer security model: your API key + mailbox ID control access; knowing the email address alone isn’t enough

- Added the new `assistantmail_reply_message` tool for replying to received emails with automatic email threading.
- Updated documentation examples to include usage of `assistantmail_reply_message`.
- Removed the sample file `skill-card.md`.
- Other documentation updated to reflect the expanded toolset.
